tool_args.rationale: All five pilot horizons are at most 0.48, while the target horizon is 21.5. The archived dual-horizon mechanism can reverse over that interval, so long-horizon observations are needed before fitting and confirming a forecast model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a static sink-gradient siphon model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The short-horizon observations cannot distinguish a static response from a response with slow endogenous adaptation.
Fine short-horizon trajectories are less directly informative about behavior at H = 21.5 than the slow-horizon probe.
It is not relevant to the identified horizon ambiguity.
